name: Add an example task and complete it
covers: cinematic intro shown once per browsing session
description: Verifies the planner offers example assignments that fit on a phone and can be completed.
steps: Open the StudyMate planner on a mobile viewport
Confirm the cinematic laptop-boy intro appears for a new browsing session
Confirm the mountain video stays fixed behind the planner while scrolling after entering the planner
Observe the welcome heading as its accent word types and changes
Open Add task and choose the Mathematics Activity example task
Click the checkbox beside the new task
Scroll to the bottom of the planner and tap Contact Support
expected: The cinematic laptop-boy intro appears at the start of a new browsing session; after entering StudyMate, the planner is usable with the supplied aerial video visible as its background. The example task appears without horizontal overflow, shows as completed, and the bottom Contact Support link opens the developer's Facebook profile.

name: Sign in and sync tasks and adaptive practice history
description: Verifies an authenticated student keeps planner progress, completed-set review, and weak topics in the account.
steps: Click Log in and complete the sign-in flow
Confirm the welcome heading uses the signed-in profile name
Complete a practice set and review its results
Refresh the page
expected: The signed-in name and the completed practice review remain available after refresh.

name: Complete a reasoning problem and see its grade
description: Verifies a reasoning problem can be answered and graded.
steps: Open Problem-Solving Practice
Enter a correct answer for a displayed problem
Click Grade my answer
expected: The problem shows a score and feedback.

name: Review all 20 answers and generate targeted next set
description: Verifies finishing all 20 problems shows every answer and grade before a new set is started, and lower-scoring topics are targeted next.
steps: Complete and grade all 20 problems
Review the SET COMPLETE panel
Confirm each problem shows the student answer, expected answer, and score
Click Generate new set
expected: The full review remains visible until the button is clicked, then a new numbered set starts with targeted questions for any weak topics.

name: Use the 25 minute study timer
description: Verifies the focus timer remains usable on a small phone viewport.
steps: Open the Study timer section
Click Start
Click Pause
Click Reset
expected: The timer starts, pauses, and returns to 25:00 without overflowing the phone layout.

name: Open the standalone dictionary and look up a word
covers: multiple definitions and pronunciation when available
description: Verifies the dictionary is separate from the planner, can look up a word online, and provides a helpful empty-result message.
steps: Tap the Dictionary tab in the main StudyMate navigation
Search for curious and submit the search
Review the definition results and any available pronunciation controls
Search for a deliberately invalid word such as qzxqzxqzx and submit
Return to the Dictionary and browse sample words by letter C
expected: The Dictionary opens as its own page without the planner content. A valid word shows online English definitions and available word details; an invalid word shows a helpful not-found message, and A–Z sample browsing works.

name: Host and join a random 10-question problem-solving quiz
covers: fresh unique 10-question problem-solving set per new room with persistent no-repeat history
solo training mode with one player
speed-based points decrease by 60 each elapsed second
host-configurable question source and answer format
answer reveal with correct-answer check and incorrect-answer X
manual Next question and Finish quiz controls
synchronized three-second countdown before each question
fresh generated questions across diverse academic and real-world topics
problem-solving-only quiz subjects with varied scenarios
original quiz sound effects and mute toggle
description: Verifies a host creates a room with ten randomly selected problem-solving questions, a second player joins, and the quiz runs through scoring and results.
steps: Actor A enters a nickname, selects random problem-solving questions, multiple choice, and a 20-second timer, then creates a room
Confirm the room contains 10 problem-solving questions and shows a 20-second timer
Actor A shares the six-digit room code
Actor B enters a nickname and joins using that code in a second browser context
Confirm both actors see the same ten questions and both players
Actor A starts the quiz
Actor B selects an answer and submits it quickly
Wait until the answer timer reaches zero
Confirm the correct option receives a check, an incorrect selected option receives an X, and the correct answer is displayed
Confirm the host can press Next question after the answer reveal
Confirm all players see a synchronized 3-second countdown before the following question begins
Confirm a correct answer scores up to 1,000 points and loses 60 points for each elapsed second
Actor A advances through all 10 questions and finishes the quiz
Finish and create a second new room, then confirm its ten randomly generated prompts use different wording and a broad mix of subjects compared with the previous room
Create a solo room and start training with only the host present
expected: Each random room contains ten questions from different categories such as science, geography, language, computing, history, logic, and mathematics, with varied wording and answer choices checked against persistent used-question history. The host can advance manually or let the reveal auto-advance, and each question begins only after all players see the synchronized three-second countdown. A solo host can train, scoring remains speed-based, answers are revealed, sound can be muted, and the final leaderboard appears.

name: Reject invalid room codes and unauthorized quiz controls
description: Verifies invalid codes and non-host control attempts are rejected with visible feedback.
steps: Open Multiplayer Quiz on a mobile viewport
Enter a nickname and an invalid six-digit room code
Submit Join room
Confirm a helpful room-not-found message appears
Join a valid waiting room as Actor B and attempt to start the quiz
expected: The invalid room code produces a visible error, and a non-host cannot start or advance the quiz.

name: Play an online chess match with legal-move and capture highlights
description: Verifies two signed-in players can move in turns and see clear legal destination and capture highlights when selecting a piece.
steps: Actor A signs in and creates an online chess room
Actor B signs in with a different account and joins the room code
Confirm both actors see the same starting board and opposite assigned colors
Select a piece that has legal moves and confirm empty legal destinations are green
Confirm a legal destination occupied by an opponent piece is red to indicate a capture
Make a legal move and confirm Actor B sees the update and can select a piece on their turn
expected: Empty legal destination squares are highlighted green, legal captures of opponent pieces are highlighted red, illegal squares remain unchanged, and both players can move only on their turns with synchronized boards.

name: Show chess game result and final duration
covers: game elapsed time and final duration
description: Verifies a completed online chess game shows a checkmark, the correct ending reason or winning color, and the final game duration.
steps: Actor A and Actor B join an online chess room
Play legal moves until checkmate or a draw condition ends the game
Confirm both players see a checkmark and a result naming the winning color or stalemate/draw reason
Confirm the elapsed game time is visible during play and the final duration remains visible after the game ends
expected: The result banner identifies White or Black as the winner when checkmate occurs, explicitly labels stalemate when applicable, shows other draw reasons when detected, and retains the final elapsed duration on both players' screens.

name: Sync room members and remove disconnected players
covers: live player list synchronization with WebSocket and polling fallback
room start after second player joins
solo training start with one player
description: Verifies a second player appears for both actors, the host can start after the room reaches two players, and leaving or disconnecting removes a player from the room.
steps: Actor A creates a room
Actor B joins using the six-digit code in a second browser context
Confirm both players appear in both room views
Actor A starts the quiz and Actor B sees the first question
Actor B leaves the room or closes the browser context
Confirm Actor A sees the player removed and the room remains responsive
expected: The player list updates for both actors, starting succeeds with two connected players, a solo host can start training with only one player, and a departing player is removed; if the host departs, a remaining player is promoted and can control the quiz.

name: Create a custom typed-answer quiz with a 10-second timer
covers: unlimited custom question bank per room
description: Verifies a host can enter their own questions, select typed answers and a 10-second timer, then run the room with the configured settings.
steps: Actor A enters a nickname
Select My own questions, Type the answer, and 10 seconds
Enter 12 question lines using Question | correct answer format
Create the room and confirm the selected settings appear in the waiting room
Actor B joins and Actor A starts
Actor B submits a correct typed answer before time expires
expected: The room uses all 12 host-entered custom prompts in randomized order, accepts typed answers case-insensitively, applies the 10-second limit, awards a speed-based score for a correct answer, reveals the correct answer with player correctness feedback after time expires, and automatically starts the next question after the reveal.

name: Play a 60-second Tug of War match
description: Verifies two players can join and play the new team mode.
steps: Actor A creates a room
Actor B joins with the code
Confirm teams are balanced
Host starts the match
Players answer problems
Confirm rope position and correct/wrong counts update
expected: The match balances teams, serves each player a sequence without repeated correct answers, moves the rope toward or away from the player's team according to correctness, and ends at the rope limit or 60-second timeout with team results.
